text: If the sides of a rectangle are given by the equations \(x = -2,\ x = 6,\ y = -2,\ y = 5\), then the equation of the circle, drawn on the diagonal of this rectangle as its diameter, is
solution: The rectangle has sides \(x=-2,\ x=6,\ y=-2,\ y=5\), so its vertices are \(A(-2,-2),\ B(6,-2),\ C(6,5),\ D(-2,5)\). A circle drawn on a diagonal as diameter passes through the two opposite vertices it joins. Taking diagonal \(AC\) with endpoints \((-2,-2)\) and \((6,5)\), the diameter form \((x-x_1)(x-x_2)+(y-y_1)(y-y_2)=0\) gives \((x+2)(x-6)+(y+2)(y-5)=0 \Rightarrow x^2-4x-12+y^2-3y-10=0 \Rightarrow x^2+y^2-4x-3y-22=0\) — option C.
